critical_code_review_comments: WrapAIHelperCard root <div> does NOT carry data-testid='wrap-ai-helper' or similar — automation has to identify cards by title text + 'Coming soon' chip. Suggest adding data-testid='wrap-ai-helper-card-{group}' (e.g. wrap-ai-helper-card-vehicle, -quote, -design, -contract, -inspection, -workflow) so future tab-by-tab automation can robustly assert presence/absence without scraping rendered text.

Test selector collision risk: the Wrap CC tab labels 'Production' overlaps with the top-level Orders sub-nav 'Production Board' button. Internal tab buttons would benefit from data-testid='wrap-tab-{key}' (e.g. wrap-tab-production, wrap-tab-install) — current scripts have to use first-match or DOM context which is fragile.

services/wrap_notifications.py html-render path is clean — internal fields are excluded by construction (only the explicit ‘safe’ args are formatted). No risk of accidental leak unless a caller passes a sensitive value as an extra row.

_render_html does not URL-escape href values — if a tenant.app_url ever contains characters like '"' or '>' the HTML could be broken. Today the app_url sources are all server-controlled, so risk is theoretical; consider html.escape() in a future hardening pass.
Carry-over from prior iterations: routes/wrap/core.py is still ~2000 lines — out of scope here but worth splitting in a future pass.
